categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Allfavor Intelligent Circuits Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). The company focuses on mid-to-high-end PCB products including high-frequency high-speed boards, multi-layer boards, HDI boards, metal-based boards, thick copper boards, flexible boards, rigid-flex boards, ceramic boards, and special material PCBs. Its products serve industries such as communication equipment, automotive electronics, new energy, industrial control, power, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including micro-blind and buried via HDI technology, high-frequency low dielectric loss materials, thermal separation copper substrates, mirror aluminum substrates, ceramic substrates with direct copper plating and direct bonding copper processes, and high-precision multilayer lamination. It emphasizes flexible, automated, and digitalized production methods supported by ERP and MES systems to handle small batch, multi-variety, and short lead-time production. The company also invests in R&D for 5G communication PCB embedded copper lamination, AI application PCBs, and advanced heat dissipation and anti-interference technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are electronic product manufacturers and PCB traders, serving nearly a thousand active clients including over a hundred listed companies. Major end markets include communication equipment (5G base stations, antennas, optical modules), automotive electronics (new energy vehicles, radar systems, battery management), new energy (energy storage, charging piles, photovoltaic and wind power), industrial control, power systems, medical devices, and emerging sectors like robotics, AI server power supplies, and low-altitude economy applications. The company operates both domestically and internationally, with significant sales in China, the US, Japan, Europe, and Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Nanjing, Shenzhen, and Zhuhai in China, with overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the United States, and Thailand. It has established a global production and sales network, with the Zhuhai region serving as a key manufacturing hub in South China. The company actively expands its overseas market presence through its subsidiaries, focusing on major electronics industry clusters in the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta regions and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Allfavor operates primarily in the midstream segment of the PCB supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of printed circuit boards. It procures raw materials such as copper clad laminates, copper foil, and other PCB substrates, and supplies finished PCB products to electronic manufacturers and distributors downstream. The company also engages in some outsourcing of production processes to external contractors to manage capacity fluctuations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-frequency high-speed PCBs, HDI boards, special metal-based substrates, and emerging products like embedded component PCBs and multi-layer LCP boards for 5G communications. It invests significantly in R&D, with a focus on improving production efficiency, product quality, and developing differentiated technologies to meet evolving market demands. Collaborations with universities and industry partners support cutting-edge research and talent development. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance automation and production flexibility.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized printed circuit boards to electronic product manufacturers and PCB traders. The company operates a direct sales model domestically and a combination of direct sales and distributor sales internationally. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of goods, using trade terms such as FOB, FCA, and DDP. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Allfavor is recognized as one of the leading PCB manufacturers in China, ranked among the top 100 PCB companies nationally and holding a top-three market share in the domestic 5G base station antenna PCB segment. It competes with other major PCB manufacturers in China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. The company differentiates itself through its focus on mid-to-high-end PCB products, advanced technology, flexible production capabilities, and strong customer relationships in specialized market segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 596 million, representing a 16.67% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose sharply by 391.81% to about RMB 23.7 million. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 1.31 billion with a stable equity base of approximately RMB 990 million and a low debt ratio of 24.21%. Production and sales volumes increased by over 28%, supported by capacity expansions and acquisitions. R&D investment was RMB 30.86 million, accounting for 5.18% of revenue, reflecting steady growth and enhanced profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-precision, high-density, and high-reliability PCB products tailored for mid-to-high-end applications. Its value proposition centers on flexible small-batch production with short lead times, advanced technological capabilities in high-frequency and multi-layer PCBs, and comprehensive customer service. The integration of intelligent manufacturing and digital management systems ensures rapid, stable delivery and quality assurance. Strategic investments in emerging technologies and markets, along with strong R&D and quality control, differentiate the company in a competitive industry.
